items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Thank you. Joanne was my youngest sister, that was the last child that made us seven, I missed…
And I wasn‘t counting either, so it‘s ok. Do you remember where you were in Dayton, Ohio. What neighborhood, where in Dayton, Ohio you grew up? What part of town in Dayton, Ohio?
